keyboard.behavior: Only authored native links/buttons are interactive. Plain avatars and stacks are not in the tab order.

guidelines: Use avatar plus avatar-img for wrapped images, or dimensions for standalone images. Give useful alt text; use empty alt only when nearby text duplicates identity.
Initials need a full identity through a named image role, not an unexplained abbreviation.
Give avatar-status its own named role=img; it is not a live region or presence service.
Use avatar-stack and its direct-child sizes. There are no avatar-group, avatar-square, avatar-link or avatar-wrapper classes.
A stack uses row-reverse and physical margin-left. Verify visual order/overlap in the actual document direction; do not infer semantic reordering.
Use native controls for actions. The core adds no avatar focus manager, data API or image-error fallback.
Configure avatar-tokens and avatar-sizes for size/status/border behavior. Hover lift is visual, not keyboard handling.

name: progress
title: Progress
lead: Communicate completion for determinate or indeterminate work.

component.name: progress
component.accessibility: Name each progress wrapper and keep aria-valuenow/min/max synchronized with its visual value. Stacked segments have their own named progressbar wrappers. Animation does not make a determinate value indeterminate or announce updates automatically.

variants.title: Labels and long labels

keyboard.behavior: Loading indicators are not controls. A native disabled loading button cannot be activated.

guidelines: No JavaScript plugin is needed to draw a spinner. The application starts/stops work and updates visibility.
Use role=status plus hidden text for a standalone loader; hide decoration when adjacent text provides the status.
Use spinner-sm for either variant; there is no standalone spinner class or variant-specific small alias.
Reduced motion slows border/grow to 1.5s; it does not stop them. spinner-rotate has no automatic reduced-motion handling.
Spinner uses currentColor. Prefer foreground utilities to border utilities, which can erase the transparent edge.
The spinner-border-tokens and spinner-grow-tokens maps are separate. The table shows border defaults; grow uses ease-in-out and spinner-grow for timing/name.
Use Progress for meaningful numeric completion; neither component automatically announces application updates.
